title: Secret Scanning Alert Location Created Event

created_at.description: The time that the alert was created in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.

anyOf.description: The time that the alert was last updated in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.

url.description: The REST API URL of the alert resource.

html_url.description: The GitHub URL of the alert resource.

locations_url.description: The REST API URL of the code locations for this alert.

resolution.description: The reason for resolving the alert.

resolved_at.description: The time that the alert was resolved in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.

resolution_comment.description: An optional comment to resolve an alert.

secret_type.description: The type of secret that secret scanning detected.

secret_type_display_name.description:
User-friendly name for the detected secret, matching the `secret_type`.
For a list of built-in patterns, see "[Supported secret scanning patterns](https://docs.github.com/code-security/secret-scanning/introduction/supported-secret-scanning-patterns#supported-secrets)."

provider.description: The provider of the secret that was detected.

provider_slug.description: The slug identifier for the provider of the secret that was detected.

secret_category.description: The category of the detected secret. `default` covers specific provider patterns and custom patterns; `generic` covers non-specific patterns and AI-detected secrets.

validity.description: The token status as of the latest validity check.

push_protection_bypassed.description: Whether push protection was bypassed for the detected secret.

push_protection_bypassed_at.description: The time that push protection was bypassed in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`.

push_protection_bypass_request_reviewer_.description: An optional comment when reviewing a push protection bypass.

push_protection_bypass_request_comment.description: An optional comment when requesting a push protection bypass.

push_protection_bypass_request_html_url.description: The URL to a push protection bypass request.

publicly_leaked.description: Whether the detected secret was publicly leaked.

multi_repo.description: Whether the detected secret was found in multiple repositories in the same organization or business.

closure_request_comment.description: An optional comment from the closure request author.

closure_request_reviewer_comment.description: An optional comment from the closure request reviewer.

metadata.description: A list of metadata key/value pairs associated with the secret scanning alert.

installation.title: Simple Installation

node_id.description: The global node ID of the installation.

type.description: The location type. Because secrets may be found in different types of resources (ie. code, comments, issues, pull requests, discussions), this field identifies the type of resource where the secret was found.

oneOf.description: Represents a 'commit' secret scanning location type. This location type shows that a secret was detected inside a commit to a repository.

path.description: The file path in the repository

start_line.description: Line number at which the secret starts in the file

end_line.description: Line number at which the secret ends in the file

start_column.description: The column at which the secret starts within the start line when the file is interpreted as 8BIT ASCII

end_column.description: The column at which the secret ends within the end line when the file is interpreted as 8BIT ASCII

blob_sha.description: SHA-1 hash ID of the associated blob

blob_url.description: The API URL to get the associated blob resource

commit_sha.description: SHA-1 hash ID of the associated commit

commit_url.description: The API URL to get the associated commit resource

html_url.description: The GitHub URL to get the associated commit resource.

oneOf.description: Represents a 'wiki_commit' secret scanning location type. This location type shows that a secret was detected inside a commit to a repository wiki.

path.description: The file path of the wiki page

start_line.description: Line number at which the secret starts in the file

end_line.description: Line number at which the secret ends in the file

start_column.description: The column at which the secret starts within the start line when the file is interpreted as 8-bit ASCII.

end_column.description: The column at which the secret ends within the end line when the file is interpreted as 8-bit ASCII.

blob_sha.description: SHA-1 hash ID of the associated blob

page_url.description: The GitHub URL to get the associated wiki page

commit_sha.description: SHA-1 hash ID of the associated commit

commit_url.description: The GitHub URL to get the associated wiki commit

oneOf.description: Represents an 'issue_title' secret scanning location type. This location type shows that a secret was detected in the title of an issue.

issue_title_url.description: The API URL to get the issue where the secret was detected.

html_url.description: The GitHub URL for the issue where the secret was detected.

oneOf.description: Represents an 'issue_body' secret scanning location type. This location type shows that a secret was detected in the body of an issue.

issue_body_url.description: The API URL to get the issue where the secret was detected.

html_url.description: The GitHub URL for the issue where the secret was detected.

oneOf.description: Represents an 'issue_comment' secret scanning location type. This location type shows that a secret was detected in a comment on an issue.

issue_comment_url.description: The API URL to get the issue comment where the secret was detected.

html_url.description: The GitHub URL for the issue comment where the secret was detected.

oneOf.description: Represents a 'discussion_title' secret scanning location type. This location type shows that a secret was detected in the title of a discussion.

discussion_title_url.description: The URL to the discussion where the secret was detected.

oneOf.description: Represents a 'discussion_body' secret scanning location type. This location type shows that a secret was detected in the body of a discussion.

discussion_body_url.description: The URL to the discussion where the secret was detected.

oneOf.description: Represents a 'discussion_comment' secret scanning location type. This location type shows that a secret was detected in a comment on a discussion.

discussion_comment_url.description: The API URL to get the discussion comment where the secret was detected.

oneOf.description: Represents a 'pull_request_title' secret scanning location type. This location type shows that a secret was detected in the title of a pull request.

pull_request_title_url.description: The API URL to get the pull request where the secret was detected.

html_url.description: The GitHub URL for the pull request where the secret was detected.

oneOf.description: Represents a 'pull_request_body' secret scanning location type. This location type shows that a secret was detected in the body of a pull request.

pull_request_body_url.description: The API URL to get the pull request where the secret was detected.

html_url.description: The GitHub URL for the pull request where the secret was detected.

oneOf.description: Represents a 'pull_request_comment' secret scanning location type. This location type shows that a secret was detected in a comment on a pull request.

pull_request_comment_url.description: The API URL to get the pull request comment where the secret was detected.

html_url.description: The GitHub URL for the pull request comment where the secret was detected.

oneOf.description: Represents a 'pull_request_review' secret scanning location type. This location type shows that a secret was detected in a review on a pull request.

pull_request_review_url.description: The API URL to get the pull request review where the secret was detected.

html_url.description: The GitHub URL for the pull request review where the secret was detected.

oneOf.description: Represents a 'pull_request_review_comment' secret scanning location type. This location type shows that a secret was detected in a review comment on a pull request.

pull_request_review_comment_url.description: The API URL to get the pull request review comment where the secret was detected.

html_url.description: The GitHub URL for the pull request review comment where the secret was detected.

organization.title: Organization Simple
organization.description:
A GitHub organization. Webhook payloads contain the `organization` property when the webhook is configured for an
organization, or when the event occurs from activity in a repository owned by an organization.

repository.title: Repository
repository.description:
The repository on GitHub where the event occurred. Webhook payloads contain the `repository` property
when the event occurs from activity in a repository.

private.description: Whether the repository is private or public.

size.description: The size of the repository, in kilobytes. Size is calculated hourly. When a repository is initially created, the size is 0.

default_branch.description: The default branch of the repository.

is_template.description: Whether this repository acts as a template that can be used to generate new repositories.

custom_properties.description: The custom properties that were defined for the repository. The keys are the custom property names, and the values are the corresponding custom property values.

pull_request_creation_policy.description: The policy controlling who can create pull requests: all or collaborators_only.

disabled.description: Returns whether or not this repository disabled.

visibility.description: The repository visibility: public, private, or internal.

allow_rebase_merge.description: Whether to allow rebase merges for pull requests.

squash_merge_commit_title.description:
The default value for a squash merge commit title:

- `PR_TITLE` - default to the pull request's title.
- `COMMIT_OR_PR_TITLE` - default to the commit's title (if only one commit) or the pull request's title (when more than one commit).

squash_merge_commit_message.description:
The default value for a squash merge commit message:

- `PR_BODY` - default to the pull request's body.
- `COMMIT_MESSAGES` - default to the branch's commit messages.
- `BLANK` - default to a blank commit message.

merge_commit_title.description:
The default value for a merge commit title.

- `PR_TITLE` - default to the pull request's title.
- `MERGE_MESSAGE` - default to the classic title for a merge message (e.g., Merge pull request #123 from branch-name).

merge_commit_message.description:
The default value for a merge commit message.

- `PR_TITLE` - default to the pull request's title.
- `PR_BODY` - default to the pull request's body.
- `BLANK` - default to a blank commit message.

allow_squash_merge.description: Whether to allow squash merges for pull requests.

allow_auto_merge.description: Whether to allow Auto-merge to be used on pull requests.

delete_branch_on_merge.description: Whether to delete head branches when pull requests are merged

allow_update_branch.description: Whether or not a pull request head branch that is behind its base branch can always be updated even if it is not required to be up to date before merging.
